clues: This city lies in the south of Bolivia. It is the largest city and the main town of its whole department.
Its air is dry, but its days stay mostly mild. It sits between harsh cold high lands and hot wet low lands.
This city was founded in 1574, long ago. It grew to be the main city of its southern department.
Its other full name is a long one: San Bernardo de la Frontera. That long saintly name is easy to retell.
It lies in a low dip in the east Andes. Local folks call that dip its Central Valley.
